title: Binance attackers used fake job interviews to pull off $6.3 billion crypto heist

claims.claim: Binance suffered a cyber attack resulting in a loss of 6.34 billion dollars in digital assets.

evidence.quote: Binance has revealed more details about the cyber attack that resulted in a $6.34 billion loss in digital assets.

claims.claim: The FBI stated that North Korea was behind the attack.

evidence.quote: The FBI says North Korea was behind the attack.

claims.claim: The theft and attack took place on October 29.

evidence.quote: The cryptocurrency exchange's statement linked to the FBI's findings that North Korea was responsible for the attack and the theft that took place on October 29.
Then on October 29, they logged into the third engineer's computer, used the credentials they stole from the first Wallet DevOps engineer and triggered a malicious script to launch the attack.

claims.claim: In June, a Wallet DevOps engineer at Binance downloaded a tampered homebrew installation for an AI coding tool.

evidence.quote: In June, a Wallet DevOps engineer working on Binance's wallet infrastructure downloaded a tampered homebrew installation for a popular AI coding tool that he found through a search engine.

claims.claim: In September, a Binance software engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform by a fake Project Director.

evidence.quote: Then in September, a software engineer who worked for Binance got a message from a "Project Director" through a legitimate job-hunting platform.

claims.claim: On October 20, the attackers used the compromised computer of the software engineer to gain control of other engineers' computers.

evidence.quote: On October 20, the attackers used the compromised computer of the software engineer to use an internal AI tool to gain control of the computers owned by the Wallet DevOps engineer and yet another one of his engineer colleagues.

claims.claim: Out of the 6.34 billion dollars worth of impacted digital assets, 2.85 billion dollars had been frozen.

evidence.quote: Of the $6.34 billion worth of digital assets impacted by the incident, $2.85 billion had been frozen.

claims.claim: As of November 3, Binance has rebuilt its affected wallet system and internal AI tools.

evidence.quote: As of November 3, the exchange has already rebuilt its affected wallet system and internal AI tools

As of November 3, the exchange has already rebuilt its affected wallet system and internal AI tools, replaced affected devices, decommissioned compromised credentials and tokens, completed enhanced security scans on employee devices and enhanced its system with AI-powered anomaly detection capabilities.
